scope: Substantive actual 3D architecture/layout checkpoint; photographic acceptance remains false.

reference.use: HD contour/structural landmark comparison only; no reference pixels enter geometry radiance or materials.

camera.reason: Shared low camera already places foreground rail and pagoda finial close to reference; the larger observed error is the hall body/roof relationship.

architecture.leftBody: The leftmost lower post/window bay is removed from the occupied wall field. Main end wall/stone platform/paving/cap cells retract coherently. Lower first retained post is the original x=-7.952162871635822 at the existing floor/beam datum.
architecture.upperFrame: Physical eight-axis grid fitted from common-camera source post contours, including a wider central bay for the plaque. Infill, frieze, pilasters, capitals and continuous receivers use the same axes.
architecture.irimoya: Main roof now has an actual gable above a lower half hip. Front/back roof profiles and outer eave points stay fixed. End-hip tile/solid panels stop at t=.44; upper end closes with a bevelled solid gable, curved bargeboard/ridge edge, real struts and infill.
architecture.bearings: Inset timber frame is connected to the wider left overhang by paired continuous cantilever members, diagonal seats and transverse end receiver. Existing root/stream/bridge bearings are retained.
architecture.paving: First cell is inset to remain within the retracted cap; existing stair/transition cut retains its supported polygon connection.
architecture.roofReceivers: Segmented closed receiver timbers and actual vertical bearing posts follow the148 halfhip underside at each x/z node, with closed seats touching the roof bottom; the former uniform fullhip-height girder is removed.
architecture.upperEnclosure: Actual closed timber upper floor and both side end frames now meet front/back wall fields; infill, lattice, friezes and beams close the otherwise open upper storey.
architecture.lowerRoofCollar: The lower roof starts at analytic intersections of its physical panel rays with the upper wall rectangle[-7.975,11.275,-4.8,4.2], replacing the unmatched constant inner parameter. Outer eaves stay fixed; top/lower skins and perimeter thickness remain closed.
architecture.gableRelief: Upper gable trusses and vertical slats project outside the closed gable skin instead of being buried inside it.

referenceContourChecks.pagoda: Seven current physical contour/finial points were measured at the same camera. Existing layout124 is already within roughly5–10pixels at selected corner contours; no independent projected point deformation is applied.
referenceContourChecks.hall: Source left body is recessed behind broad projecting eaves. The initial visible lower capital projected576,585; removing its excess bay retains the next supported post at643,577. Upper axes are fit as one physical grid with the central wider opening.
referenceContourChecks.limitations: Observed points are approximate; selected projection agreement is not photographic fidelity or a survey.

reflection: Only the independent Reflector projection temporarily clears viewOffset for native detail; original main camera matrices are restored in finally.
remainingGaps: Roof/corner profiles, carving, facade depth and some hall/pagoda relationships remain approximate.
Existing bank, stream, foliage, lighting and material photographic gaps are deliberately preserved for this architecture phase.
Single-view hidden depths and structural spans are inferred, not measured engineering dimensions.
